# High Adventure Bases

For Scouts, Units, Families, and Non-Scouting Adventurers

Our four unique high-adventure bases across the United States offer Scouts the
outdoor adventure of a lifetime, which is core to Scouting’s mission. National
High Adventure Treks offered at each our four high-adventure bases are a
multitude of specialized seasonal programs, from backpacking treks, to winter
expeditions, to ocean adventures, these Treks will be sure to bring
exploration to new heights. Brands like yours can be at the forefront of these
adventures through sponsored gear, backpackable snacks, STEM preparation
programs, and more!



In addition to Scouting summer camps and backcountry treks, our high-adventure
bases host a wide variety of non-Scouting events and programs and are always
looking for brand partners for highly attended events with captivated
audiences! If’d like to learn more about these opportunities…

Summit Bechtel Reserve

West Virginia

Located in the Appalachian Mountains, the Summit boasts state-of-the-art
lodging, dining, and meeting facilities and world-class outdoor recreation.
Whether it’s paddling inflatable kayaks down whitewater rapids, racing ATVs on
backcountry tracks, or sharpening archery skills — there’s a super-charged
outdoor adventure waiting for everyone. As the official host of the National
Jamboree, the Summit brings thousands of Scouts to property through summer
camps and hosts a wide variety of non-Scouting events including weddings,
church groups, school outings, triathlons, bike races, and music festivals.

[ Visit Summit BSA Website ](https://www.summitbsa.org)

[ Visit Summit Events Website ](https://summiteventswv.com/)

Philmont Scout Ranch

New Mexico

Philmont Scout Ranch offers 214-square miles of rugged northern New Mexico
wilderness. Experience backpacking treks, horseback cavalcades, and challenges
such as rock climbing, mountain biking, and range and target sports. Philmont
Scout Ranch even offers training, service programs, and best of the old west
programs – burro packing, gold panning, chuckwagon dinners, and interpretive
history. It’s an unbeatable recipe for fast-paced fun in the outdoors!

[ Visit Philmont Website ](https://www.philmontscoutranch.org/)

logo-2-rgb-2@3x.png)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20360%20360%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Sea Base

Florida Keys

Sea Base offers aquatic programs including sailing, scuba diving, fishing,
ocean kayaking, paddle boarding, and rustic camping on an undeveloped barrier
island. Sea Base also boasts one of the largest coral restoration projects in
the country. Through the micro-fragmentation technique, the Brinton
Environmental Center Coral Nursery (BEC) expedites coral growth in our ocean
bed. Scouts participate in this STEM activity first-hand for the ultimate
maritime adventure!

[ Visit Sea Base Website ](https://www.bsaseabase.org/)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/10/image-8@3x.png)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%20471%20360%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Northern Tier

Minnesota

From incredible canoe journeys to winter wilderness camping, Northern Tier
promises the adventure of a lifetime. Explore millions of acres of pristine
lakes, meandering rivers, dense forests and wetlands in the Great North Woods
of northern Minnesota and Canada

[ Visit Northern Tier Website ](https://www.ntier.org/)

Family Adventure Camp

Your adventure, your way

Experience the great outdoors on a one-of-a-kind vacation for Scouting and
non-Scouting adventurers of all ages! Choose from three incredible high-
adventure base destinations: West Virginia, New Mexico, and Florida. From
bunkhouse rooms to luxury tents, each location offers lodging options that
keep you connected to what matters most: nature, and each other. Enjoy epic
activities offered at each unique location, including swimming, hiking,
horseback riding, ziplining, whitewater rafting, and much more.

[ Get In Touch ](https://www.scouting.org/national-high-adventure-
bases/family-adventure-camp/)
